name: VirusTotal Premium
description: VirusTotal Premium-API pivots. Infrastructure: internet-scanning port data and per-port history (vt_port_info, vt_port_history), historical certificates (vt_relationships), WHOIS history with registrant and name-server pivots (vt_whois_history), and the files and URLs tied to a host (vt_host_files, vt_host_urls). Intelligence search, typed or built from a node — shared SSH host key, certificate, JARM, WHOIS registrant, a string inside files, or file similarity (vt_search, vt_search_from_node). Files: the IPs/domains/URLs a sample contacts, embeds or was distributed from (vt_file_network), its related samples (vt_file_relatives), and its sandbox MITRE techniques, YARA/Sigma/IDS matches and family (vt_file_behaviour). Needs the analyst's own VirusTotal Premium API key (VirusTotal Enterprise / Google Threat Intelligence); a community key cannot read these. Desktop only.

plugins.name: VT Port Info
plugins.description: Reads VirusTotal's internet-scanning port data for each selected IP Address (Premium key only) and writes its observable surface: vt_open_ports, vt_services (product per port), vt_closed_ports (VT keeps closed/recently-closed ports — a timestamped record of a port going down), vt_jarm and vt_ports_scanned (freshness). Materialises each SSH host key as an SSH Host Key node linked 'presents host key' (SHA-256 as hex, VirusTotal's OpenSSH spelling kept as vt_fingerprint), so it can be pivoted with VT Search from Node. A community key returns no port data and the run says so. Desktop only.

network.purpose: Read VirusTotal port_info for an IP

plugins.name: VT Search
plugins.description: Runs a VirusTotal Intelligence search query (as typed, like a Censys/Shodan search) and adds what it matches: hosts as IP Addresses, domains as Domains, URLs as URLs, files as File Hashes. The query decides the entity and the pivot — e.g. 'entity:ip fingerprint:"<ssh host key or JARM>"', 'entity:ip port_service_product[443]:nginx open_port:22', 'entity:ip ssl_subject:example.com'. Needs a VirusTotal Premium key; each search costs intelligence quota. Desktop only.

query.title: VT Intelligence query
query.description: A VirusTotal Intelligence search query, run verbatim. Start with the entity: 'entity:ip' (also entity:domain, entity:url, entity:file). Premium internet-scanning modifiers: port / open_port / closed_port / port_status / port_protocol / port_service_product / port_service_version / port_service_cpe / port_banner / os_type / device_type / fingerprint (matches the SSH host-key fingerprint and JARM) / ssl_subject / ssl_thumbprint. Pin a condition to one port with brackets, e.g. port_service_product[80]:nginx. Full syntax: VT Intelligence search documentation.

plugins.name: VT Search from Node
plugins.description: Pivots from each selected node by building a VirusTotal Intelligence query from it and adding what matches, the matches of the pivot's target linked back to the source. Pivot 'auto' picks the natural query per type: an SSH Host Key or an IP Address's JARM on fingerprint: (hosts linked 'shares SSH host key (VT)' / 'shares JARM (VT)'), a TLS Certificate on its subject or thumbprint ('shares certificate subject (VT)' / 'shares certificate thumbprint (VT)'), a Domain on ssl_subject: ('certificate names this domain (VT)'), an Email Address or Organization on whois: (domains linked 'WHOIS names this email (VT)' / 'WHOIS names this organization (VT)'), a File Hash on its vhash, else imphash, else main icon (files linked 'shares vhash (VT)' / 'shares imphash (VT)' / 'shares main icon (VT)'), a URL on content: (files linked 'contains this string (VT content search)'). Pivot 'content' finds the files containing a Domain, IP Address or URL string ('contains this string (VT content search)'); 'whois' finds the domains whose WHOIS names a Domain ('WHOIS mentions this domain (VT)'), Email Address or Organization; 'imphash', 'vhash' and 'icon' pick that File Hash pivot. VirusTotal's pseudonymised organization names, truncated emails and privacy-proxy placeholders are skipped. Each pivot costs intelligence quota. Needs a VirusTotal Premium key. Desktop only.

pivot.title: Pivot
pivot.description: auto: the natural pivot per node type (SSH key/JARM → fingerprint, cert → subject/thumbprint, domain → ssl_subject, email/org → whois, file → vhash, URL → content). content: files containing the value. whois: domains whose WHOIS names it. imphash/vhash/icon: similar files; others are skipped.

network.purpose: Pivot a node through VirusTotal Intelligence search

plugins.name: VT Port History
plugins.description: For each selected IP Address, reads VirusTotal's per-port state (first seen, open since, last seen open, current status) for its ports and writes a compact vt_port_history timeline onto the IP. VirusTotal keeps closed ports, so a port that went down shows as RECENTLY-CLOSED with the date it was last open — a forensic timeline the other scanners do not expose. Needs a VirusTotal Premium key. Desktop only.

port.title: Port (optional)
port.description: A single port to read; leave empty to read all ports VirusTotal has seen on the IP.

network.purpose: Read VirusTotal per-port history for an IP

plugins.name: VT Historical Certificates
plugins.description: Walks VirusTotal's historical SSL/TLS certificates for each selected IP Address or Domain (Premium relationship) and adds each certificate it presented over time as a TLS Certificate linked 'presented certificate' — SHA-256 thumbprint, subject CN, issuer, serial, validity (ISO-8601) and SAN count, the same fields the VirusTotal Community pack writes. This recovers rotated or expired certificates that a current-cert pivot misses. Needs a VirusTotal Premium key. Desktop only.

plugins.name: VT WHOIS History
plugins.description: Reads VirusTotal's WHOIS history for each selected Domain or IP Address and writes the changes as a timeline onto it: vt_whois_history (registrar, registrant organization and email, name servers per change — the RIR holder, net name and range for an IP) and vt_whois_snapshots. For a Domain it also adds each registrant email as an Email Address linked 'registrant email (WHOIS history)' (VirusTotal's pseudonymised addresses are kept with vt_pseudonymised — they are still searchable), each registrant organization as an Organization linked 'registrant organization (WHOIS history)', and each name server as a Domain linked 'name server (WHOIS history)'. Privacy-proxy placeholders, empty values such as N/A, truncated emails and 16-hex pseudonymised names are skipped. Needs a VirusTotal Premium key. Desktop only.

limit.title: Snapshots per node
limit.description: How many of the most recent WHOIS snapshots to read per node (1–100, default 20).

plugins.name: VT Host Files
plugins.description: For each selected IP Address, Domain or URL, reads the files VirusTotal ties to it and adds each as a File Hash (hashes, file type, detection counts, threat label): files that contact it, linked file → host 'communicates with' (malware using it as C2); files it served, linked host → file 'served file'; and, when ticked, files whose content names it, linked file → host 'references'. A file that both contacts and names the host gets one file → host edge carrying both labels ('communicates with; references'). Listed hashes VirusTotal holds no report for are skipped and counted as unreported. Needs a VirusTotal Premium key. Desktop only.

communicating.title: Communicating files
communicating.description: Files that contact this host — malware using it as C2.

downloaded.title: Downloaded files
downloaded.description: Files VirusTotal saw served from this host.

referrer.title: Referrer files
referrer.description: Files whose content references this host.

limit.title: Max files per relationship
limit.description: Files to read per relationship for each node (1–200, default 20). Every 40 costs one request.

network.purpose: Read the files VirusTotal relates to a host

plugins.name: VT Host URLs
plugins.description: For each selected IP Address or Domain, reads the URLs VirusTotal has seen on it and adds each as a URL (page title, HTTP status, final URL, detection counts) linked host → URL 'hosts URL'. Needs a VirusTotal Premium key. Desktop only.

limit.title: Max URLs per node
limit.description: URLs to read for each node (1–200, default 20). Every 40 costs one request.

network.purpose: Read the URLs VirusTotal has seen on a host

plugins.name: VT File Network
plugins.description: For each selected File Hash, reads VirusTotal's network relationships and adds the IP Addresses, Domains and URLs around it: what the file contacted when detonated in VirusTotal's sandboxes (linked 'contacts (sandbox)'), what is embedded in it as strings (linked 'embeds'), and where it was seen distributed in the wild (linked 'distributed from (in the wild)'). An entity found more than one way gets one edge naming each, e.g. 'contacts (sandbox); embeds'. Reverse-DNS (in-addr.arpa) lookups are dropped. Needs a VirusTotal Premium key. Desktop only.

contacted.title: Contacted (sandbox)
contacted.description: IPs/domains/URLs the file contacted when detonated in VirusTotal's sandboxes.

embedded.title: Embedded
embedded.description: IPs/domains/URLs found as strings inside the file.

itw.title: In the wild
itw.description: Where the file was seen distributed in the wild.

network.purpose: Read a file's network relationships from VirusTotal

plugins.name: VT File Relatives
plugins.description: For each selected File Hash, reads VirusTotal's file relationships and adds the related files as File Hashes: files VirusTotal finds similar (linked 'similar to (VT)'; the file itself is never linked), files that launched it (linked 'executed'), files it dropped when detonated (linked 'dropped'), and — when switched on — archives that contain it and files bundled inside it (linked 'contains'). A file related more than one way in the same direction gets one edge naming each, e.g. 'executed; contains'. Needs a VirusTotal Premium key. Desktop only.

similar.title: Similar files
similar.description: Files VirusTotal clusters as similar to this one (same family, rebuilt or repacked).

execution_parents.title: Execution parents
execution_parents.description: Files that launched this file when detonated — droppers, installers, archives.

dropped.title: Dropped files
dropped.description: Files this file wrote to disk when detonated.

compressed_parents.title: Compressed parents
compressed_parents.description: Archives that contain this file — often hundreds for a popular sample.

bundled.title: Bundled files
bundled.description: Files packed inside this file when it is an archive or installer.

network.purpose: Read a file's related files from VirusTotal

plugins.name: VT File Behaviour
plugins.description: For each selected File Hash, reads VirusTotal's file report and its sandboxes' MITRE ATT&CK trees and adds what they found: ATT&CK techniques as Attack Patterns linked 'exhibits (sandbox)' (a technique VirusTotal reports under a retired ID and its current one is one Attack Pattern, kept under the current ID), crowdsourced YARA, Sigma and IDS hits as Detection Signatures linked 'matches YARA rule', 'matches Sigma rule' and 'triggers IDS rule', and the top AV family names as Malware linked 'classified as'. Writes vt_threat_label, vt_threat_category, vt_sandbox_verdicts and vt_mitre_sandboxes onto the file. Needs a VirusTotal Premium key. Desktop only.

mitre.title: MITRE ATT&CK techniques
mitre.description: Techniques VirusTotal's sandboxes observed when detonating the file.

yara.title: YARA rules
yara.description: Crowdsourced YARA rules that match the file.

sigma.title: Sigma rules
sigma.description: Sigma rules that matched the sandboxes' event logs.

ids.title: IDS alerts
ids.description: IDS (Snort/Suricata) alerts on the sandboxes' network capture — noisy (ICMP, Tor exit lists).

classification.title: Threat classification
classification.description: Top AV family names as Malware, plus the threat label, category and sandbox verdicts on the file.

max_per_kind.title: Max per kind
max_per_kind.description: Techniques / YARA / Sigma / IDS entries kept per file, each (1–100, default 25).

network.purpose: Read a file's report and sandbox ATT&CK trees from VirusTotal
